This low-ranking [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''officer''' served on the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth campaign]] of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. When Vader summoned several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to the ''Executor'' to help the Imperial hunt for [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], this officer acted as the personal escort of the bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] through the ''Executor''{{'s}} corridors from [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] to [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]].

This officer, although visibly uncomfortable in the presence of Fett, was eager to learn of the bounty hunter's past history with Solo, whom the officer had heard assisted [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in destroying the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
